item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las rnga rabs sgra rgyal 'brug gi sgra dbyangs
item.coloph: gsung dbyangs rnga yi bsrid (srid) tshul thugs dam skong ba'i man ngag byad kha zlog pa'i gzer bu/ sgra rgyal 'brug gi sgra dbyangs/ zhes bya ba stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ pad ma 'byung gnas la dka' ba du ma spyad nas zhus/ dam ldan bu yis spyod yul te/ dam med dgra la gsang rgya thob/ u ya ag tham/ sa ma ya/ shin tu gnyen pa'i mchog yin pas/ gar thod thod la ma sbyin cig stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge'o//
